audit.title: Security Audit Report: Sprint 2.1 Keyword Discovery Implementation
audit.scope: Keyword discovery integration (GSC, Google Suggest, Reddit, PAA, Competitors)

summary.recommendation: ITERATE - Implement critical fixes before production release

vulnerabilities.title: No Input Validation on niche Parameter
vulnerabilities.description: The niche parameter is passed directly to subreddit queries and database filters without validation. This user-controlled parameter can be 255+ characters, enabling NoSQL injection, XSS via stored data, and buffer overflow attacks.
vulnerabilities.attackVector: User-supplied niche parameter in API calls
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement validateNiche() function with: max 200 char limit, alphanumeric+space+hyphen+underscore whitelist, normalize whitespace

vulnerabilities.title: Missing SSRF Protection on Google Suggest
vulnerabilities.description: Google Suggest collector constructs URLs using user-controlled query parameters without validation. Attacker can manipulate language/country parameters for CRLF injection and header manipulation.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - SSRF, HTTP header injection, internal API access
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Malicious language/country parameter: '../../../internal' or CRLF injection
vulnerabilities.remediation: Whitelist supported languages/countries, validate parameters before URL construction, reject invalid values

vulnerabilities.title: Information Disclosure in Error Messages
vulnerabilities.description: Error messages expose internal API endpoints, full error details, and stack traces to users and logs. Enables information gathering, path disclosure, and API endpoint mapping.
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Trigger API errors to expose internal structure
vulnerabilities.remediation: Create error classes per module, return generic errors to users, log detailed errors server-side only

vulnerabilities.title: Seed Keywords Not Validated
vulnerabilities.description: Seed keywords passed to batch collection lack any validation for length or content. Could enable DoS via large keywords, memory exhaustion, or injection attacks.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate array length (max 1000), validate each keyword (max 500 chars), sanitize control characters

vulnerabilities.title: Inadequate Rate Limiting
vulnerabilities.description: Rate limiting uses fixed delays (100ms, 500ms, 1000ms) without adaptive throttling or cumulative limits across collectors. Cannot adapt to API quota changes or prevent accidental DoS.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - API quota exhaustion, undetected overuse, cost overruns
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Rapid batch requests exhausting API quota
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement AdaptiveRateLimiter class with configurable requests/minute, burst size, and sliding window algorithm

vulnerabilities.title: No API Key Rotation Support
vulnerabilities.description: API credentials loaded at startup and cached for entire application lifetime. No support for key rotation or emergency revocation without application restart.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - Compromised credentials persist, no emergency response path
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Stolen credential cannot be revoked until app restart
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement CredentialStore interface with getToken(), refreshToken(), revokeToken() methods. Add token TTL and refresh logic.

vulnerabilities.title: Insufficient Data Sanitization (Reddit Titles)
vulnerabilities.description: Reddit post titles stored directly without HTML/script sanitization. Could contain HTML entities, scripts, or XSS payloads that persist in database.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - Stored XSS, injection in downstream systems
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Reddit post with title containing <script> tags
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement sanitizeText() function: remove null bytes, decode/remove HTML entities, remove script tags, strip event handlers, enforce max length

vulnerabilities.title: Missing taskId Validation
vulnerabilities.description: taskId parameter not validated. Could contain path traversal sequences if used in file operations, cache keys, or logging.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - Path traversal, cache key collision, log injection
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Supply taskId with ../ sequences for path traversal
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate taskId as UUID or alphanumeric+hyphen+underscore (max 64 chars), reject path traversal patterns

vulnerabilities.title: Subreddit Name Not Validated
vulnerabilities.description: Subreddit names passed to queryReddit() lack validation, enabling path traversal and query injection into Reddit URLs.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - Path traversal, SSRF, query injection
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate subreddit as alphanumeric+underscore+hyphen (max 21 chars), reject path traversal and special characters

vulnerabilities.title: No Environment Variable Validation on Startup
vulnerabilities.description: API keys loaded from environment but never validated for format or length. Invalid/expired keys only detected during first API call, causing confusing runtime errors.
vulnerabilities.impact: High - Silent failures, confusing errors, audit bypass
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Application starts with invalid credentials, no startup validation
vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement validateEnvironment() function at startup, validate all required credentials, fail fast with clear error messages

vulnerabilities.title: Embedding Cache Not Encrypted
vulnerabilities.description: Cached embeddings stored in plain text in RuVector database. Embeddings can be reverse-engineered to recover original keywords, violating privacy.
vulnerabilities.impact: Medium - Data breach risk, keyword discovery, privacy violation
vulnerabilities.attackVector: Database breach exposes plaintext embeddings and keywords
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add AES-256-GCM encryption for embeddings, implement EMBEDDING_ENCRYPTION_KEY environment variable, store encryption metadata

vulnerabilities.title: Cache Hit Rate Logging May Expose API Usage Patterns
vulnerabilities.description: Verbose logging of cache hit/miss rates and API call counts could expose usage patterns to attackers with log access.
vulnerabilities.impact: Medium - Information disclosure, usage pattern analysis
vulnerabilities.remediation: Move detailed analytics to secure logging channel, limit production logging to errors only

vulnerabilities.title: Verbose Console Logging of Sensitive Operations
vulnerabilities.description: Console logging includes API endpoints, operation details, and timing information that could aid attackers.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use structured logging with log levels, avoid logging sensitive details in production

vulnerabilities.title: No Credentials Expiration Warnings
vulnerabilities.description: No mechanism to warn when API credentials are approaching expiration, leading to unexpected service disruption.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Track credential age, log warnings when approaching expiration (30/7/1 days), require rotation
